response_text:
Several **donor / fundraising CRMs integrate directly with QuickBooks**, so you can track donors and campaigns while keeping accounting in sync and avoiding double entry.

Here are strong options, all designed for nonprofits:

| Tool | Type | QuickBooks version | Key integration features |
|------|------|--------------------|--------------------------|
| **DonorSnap** | Donor management / CRM | **Online + Desktop** | Direct integration at no extra cost; map DonorSnap accounting codes and payment methods to QB income and asset accounts; send selected transactions in batches to QB GL.[1] |
| **DonorPerfect** | Donor management / CRM | **Online** | Automatic sync of gift data and expenses; post to existing GL; map gifts to bank accounts, income accounts, and classes; map donors to QB customers; QuickBooks Online can be purchased via DonorPerfect.[3][4] |
| **Bloomerang** | Donor CRM | **Online + Desktop** | Sync donor transactions from Bloomerang to QB; map donations to specific accounts and fields; supports automatic sync with QBO and IIF export tools for QB Desktop.[5] |
| **Funraise** | Online fundraising platform | **Online** | Send donation and donor data to QBO; create Sales Receipts and Customers; customize fee reporting; map Account, Class, Product/Service fields.[2] |
| **Donorbox** | Donation form / fundraising | **Online** | Automatically sync one‑time & recurring donations, ticket sales, and other transactions from Donorbox into QBO.[8] |
| **OnlineGiving.org** | Online giving platform | **Online + Desktop** | Integration for batch deposits, account & class mapping, cover‑the‑fee handling, OAuth authentication.[9] |
| **DonorDock (via Zapier)** | Donor management / CRM | **Online (via Zapier)** | Uses Zapier connector to push data to QBO; no extra fee from DonorDock, but requires a (usually paid) Zapier plan.[7] |

### How to choose among them

Consider:

- **Do you need a full donor CRM or just donation → QuickBooks sync?**  
  - Full CRMs: **DonorSnap, DonorPerfect, Bloomerang, DonorDock**.[1][3][5][7]  
  - Primarily fundraising / forms with sync: **Funraise, Donorbox, OnlineGiving.org**.[2][8][9]

- **QuickBooks flavor**  
  - Need **QuickBooks Desktop** support: look at **DonorSnap** (direct), **Bloomerang** (IIF export), or **OnlineGiving.org**.[1][5][9]  
  - If you use **QuickBooks Online only**, all of the above will work.

- **Depth of accounting mapping**  
  - For more granular financial control (accounts, classes, bank accounts), look at **DonorPerfect** and **Bloomerang** (rich mapping), plus **Funraise** and **OnlineGiving.org** for detailed field mapping.[2][3][5][9]

- **Cost and setup complexity**  
  - DonorSnap’s QB integration is included “for no extra cost.”[1]  
  - DonorDock uses Zapier (added Zapier subscription for more robust zaps).[7]  
  - Others bundle QB integration into mid‑ or upper‑tier plans; specifics depend on current pricing.

### Practical next step

If you tell me:
- whether you’re on **QuickBooks Online or Desktop**,  
- approximate **donor database size**,  
- whether you want **online giving pages / events** built‑in,  

I can narrow this down to 2–3 best‑fit recommendations and outline how the sync would work day‑to‑day for your situation.
